name: spinner
title: Spinner
description: A spinning mark that says “still working” without blocking the page. Inline loads and button pending states.

discovery.name: Spinner
discovery.description: A spinning mark that says “still working” without blocking the page. Inline loads and button pending states.

configurables.what: Visual scale of the spinner mark.
configurables.how: m inside buttons and default UI; xs/s for dense tables; l for page-level loading. Default: m.

gotchas.note: Root already exposes role=status and aria-label=Loading; do not nest another live region around it.
Decorative only — pair with disabled buttons or skeleton content so users know what is loading.
